meta.note: The Isle of Man has 26 official Dark Sky Discovery Sites - the highest concentration anywhere in the British Isles. All are publicly accessible.
advice: Let your eyes adapt for 20 minutes - avoid looking at your phone.
Use a red torch if you have one; white light ruins night vision.
Dress far warmer than you think you need to.
Tell someone where you are going, and take a charged phone.
Park considerately and take all litter home.

sites.name: Smeale Coastal Area
sites.description: One of the Island's darkest sites with near to no light pollution. Totally uninterrupted horizon views.
sites.mapsQuery: Smeale Coastal Area, Smeale, Andreas, Isle of Man

sites.name: The Sound
sites.address: Sound Road, Port St Mary, IM9 5PZ
sites.description: The Island's southern tip and one of the most scenic places in the British Isles. Large car park, benches and grass. Listen for seals on Kitterland.
sites.mapsQuery: The Sound, Sound Road, Port St Mary, IM9 5PZ, Isle of Man

sites.name: The Sloc Car Park

sites.mapsQuery: The Sloc Car Park, A36, Port Erin, Isle of Man

sites.name: Fort Island
